criteria.criterion: Concern is expressed as the author’s unresolved question within the sources actually consulted, with a concrete research limit. Avoid absolute claims that no public information exists or that the industry conceals it. A stronger concern must not become a stronger factual allegation.

Acknowledge already documented source-author, screenwriter, translator and collaborator credits. Missing payment terms must not erase those credits. Distinguish attribution, permission, contractual rights, remuneration and actual receipt of money.

No inference of nonpayment, missed payment, exploitation, unfair treatment, typical practice or causal livelihood harm from inaccessible agreements or unreported fees. Absence of evidence remains an unanswered question, not a verdict about named makers.

NBT book-publication royalties remain book royalties; Kher-to-Patnaik Hindi remake token remains a different transaction. Neither establishes the original story author’s adaptation fee. Hypothetical fair agreements remain proposals, not documented existing outcomes.

Give particular choices, obstacles and attributed experiences room to differ. Cut interchangeable moral summaries without flattening disagreement, inventing motives or turning brief evidence into a fuller biography than it supports.

The author’s memoir/encounters, participant recollections in published sources, literary interpretation and present proposals remain distinguishable. No invented viewing, listening, remembered dialogue, witnessed gesture, interview or scene.

Preserve concise attribution and material limits on award categories/years, restoration, language/geography, reported commercial estimates and programme versus film outcomes. Maintain genuine creator/source/licence credits and citation destinations.

Optional core journey provides a reason to continue, without implying other readings are disposable or making all50 mandatory. Preserve all50 articles, seven-part structure unless expressly changed, existing images and working routes; selected chapters should actually carry the concern promised by the route.

Ending acknowledges what the inquiry established and what remains unresolved before inviting action. Retain five effectuation principles and unpaid-labour safeguard, avoid time-bound project plan, triumphalism, guaranteed readership/income or generic extra conclusion.

Only after candidate-ready: bind changed sources/plan and actual book hashes; inspect selected affected pages, note/link integrity and metadata. Preserve previous editions. Distinguish independent AI QA from human specialist approval, and prepared reader questions from completed reader testing. No publication claim.
